    """Return the usable value from Sheet1, using cached formula value when the editable workbook has a formula."""
    v = ws1.cell(row, col).value

    """Return the usable count value from Sheet1's count column, if available."""
    if col is None or col > ws1.max_column:
        return None
    v = ws1.cell(row, col).value
    if isinstance(v, str) and v.startswith("="):
        return ws1_data.cell(row, col).value
    return v

    return isinstance(v, numbers.Number) and not isinstance(v, bool)

if non_empty != expected_non_empty:

# Confirm no cell values outside answer_position changed.
